summary: Frontend regression pass after useCallback/useEffect memoization cleanup (part A). All 8 target flows verified: no infinite loops, single-shot fetches, abandoned toggle round-trip correct, single promo toast on auto-apply, Messages floor options limited to allowed values (legacy Mainstream only visible disabled when a record already has that value), /vi language persistence + saved-lang redirect + globe-switch to /en all correct within 1 hop, 3 takeover-video-slots present, Scanner logs invalid codes correctly with newest on top, /upgrade shows 'Ticket not found' for unknown code and 400 Kč CTA for ATF-63BBC9.

admin_tabs_no_infinite_loop.overview: Initial /api/admin/stats fired twice on mount (double invocation, likely React StrictMode); no additional fetches after 3s idle. No loop.
admin_tabs_no_infinite_loop.orders: 1 GET /api/admin/orders + 1 GET /api/admin/ambassadors on tab open (each doubled once = 2 orders+2 amb), then idle. No loop.
admin_tabs_no_infinite_loop.tiers: 2 GET /api/admin/tiers + 2 GET /api/admin/events (doubled), then idle. No loop.
admin_tabs_no_infinite_loop.content: No admin/* API calls (all client-side content). OK.
admin_tabs_no_infinite_loop.note: Every tab does exactly one logical fetch per resource; the observed x2 count is React 18 StrictMode dev double-invocation, NOT a hook-dep loop. No repeated calls once effects settle. Regression criterion met.

detailed_findings.abandoned_toggle: Exactly ONE GET /api/admin/orders?include_unpaid=1 on OFF→ON and ONE GET /api/admin/orders on ON→OFF. Effect-driven reload works as intended.
detailed_findings.messages_floor_options: Verified in code (Admin.js L917-923): dropdown renders only 'No floor assigned' + Seoul (7th) + Saigon (5th); if a message already has a legacy floor (e.g. 'Mainstream Floor (6th)'), it appears as disabled '(legacy)' option to preserve display without allowing new assignment. Consistent with requirement.
detailed_findings.tickets_ref_auto_apply: GET /tickets?ref=T5915F8 → after clicking BUY: exactly ONE 'Discount applied — 50 Kč off per ticket' toast; input pre-filled with T5915F8; total 449 Kč. Manual apply of MZYPL5BKOD → 'Discount applied — 95% off' toast, line 'Code MZYPL5BKOD applied: −95% (list price 499 Kč)', total 25 Kč. Payment not attempted.

language.root_after_vi: Visiting / redirects to /vi (saved lang). Single hop, no flicker.
language.switch_to_en: Globe picker → /en. Single hop, no loop.

detailed_findings.scanner: Admin login → 2 manual entries (ATF-ZZZZZZ, ATF-YYYYYY) → both show INVALID; door log shows newest on top (ATF-YYYYYY 22:25:12 above ATF-ZZZZZZ 22:25:09). No console errors beyond pre-login 401 auth probes.
detailed_findings.upgrade_page: ATF-XXXXXX → 'Ticket not found' toast (text confirmed). ATF-63BBC9 → Ticket Found card with 'Sim Guard Test · 1st Release', PAY UPGRADE — 400 KČ visible. Stopped before payment.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin.js is 1174 lines — consider splitting each tab into its own module (OverviewTab, OrdersTab, etc.) for maintainability and to reduce re-render surface.
Overview shows Recharts width(-1) height(-1) warnings — chart container needs minWidth/minHeight or explicit dimensions before initial paint.

There is a React hydration warning on the messages floor select: a <span data-ve-dynamic> is being injected as a child of <option> by the editor instrumentation. Not a runtime crash and not caused by this batch, but flag it for future cleanup.
Initial /api/admin/stats fires twice on mount; if this is production build (not StrictMode), review Overview useEffect deps to ensure load() runs only once.
seed_data_creation: None. No admin messages edited/saved. No orders created. No payments attempted (per Teya-live constraint). Scanner door log entries are ephemeral client-side state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression clean. Ambassador codes: active T5915F8 (-50 Kč), TBA6D26. Promo MZYPL5BKOD = -95%. Valid paid ticket for /upgrade: ATF-63BBC9. Do not enter card details (real Teya).
